input.question: What gives a band's music the distinct sound that allows you to identify the band even if you've never heard the song?
input.ground_truth: Musical style, of course. But also the selection of instruments and how they are played. I work as a sound engineer, and there are a few of my friends i can recognize when are playing. And I guess in the same way you might recognize an author through the writing style, you might also recognize the way the music is composed.

Okay! Imagine every band is like a different kind of cookie.

Even if you’ve never eaten a certain cookie before, you might be able to tell if it’s a chocolate chip cookie or a sugar cookie just by the way it looks, smells, or tastes a little bit. That’s because each kind of cookie has its own special way of being made.

It’s the same with a band’s music. Each band has its own special way of playing the instruments, singing, and putting the music together. Maybe one band always uses a certain kind of guitar sound, or maybe their singer’s voice sounds really happy or really deep. All these little things together make their music sound special and different from other bands. So, even if you don’t know the song, you might still be able to guess which band it is because of their special “cookie recipe” sound!
